description: Pasting your own Agent invitation into the browser's Join a project form is accepted. The invitation is used up, the setup agent is re-enrolled, no new Actor is created, and the page silently returns to the existing board with no message.
expected: The Join form refuses Agent invitations as the Link this device form does ('Agent invitations are for your agent, not this browser.'), or at least says what happened.
actual: Invite state becomes `redeemed`; actor list unchanged; no confirmation or warning shown.
suggested_fix: Apply the same purpose check the Link this device form uses before submitting; have the server reject purpose=agent redemption from a browser human session.

description: Joining with an invitation that this same person already redeemed returns `INVITE_USED: Invitation belongs to a different recipient`.
expected: 'This invitation was already used' plus when or by which Actor.
actual: The message says 'different recipient' although the recipient is the same person and harness.
suggested_fix: Use a message that states the invitation has been used; keep the recipient detail in error details.

description: The invitation history shows identical rows ('Agent · Waiting to be used', 'Agent · Used') with no creation time, creator or recipient, so two open invitations cannot be told apart and a used one does not say who used it.
expected: Each row shows when it was created and, once used, which Actor it enrolled (e.g. 'Used by Gamma · 11:40').
actual: Rows differ only by expiry minute; 'Used' rows have no detail.
suggested_fix: Add created-at and redeemed-by Actor name to invitation rows.

description: `client join` with harness metadata returns the project with the human `actorId`; it never names the agent Actor that was just enrolled.
expected: The join result includes the enrolled agent (`agent:{actorId, harnessId, name}`).
actual: Only the person's actorId; the agent's ID first appears after a separate agent-grant.
suggested_fix: Return the enrolled agent Actor in the join result.
